We are looking for a skilled Data Engineer with solid experience in the Azure data ecosystem and hands-on expertise in Azure Databricks. You will contribute to building and optimizing data lakehouse and warehouse architectures, enabling efficient data ingestion, transformation, and analytics in a collaborative team environment.

title: Google Cloud Engineer
jobDescription:
Overview of 66degrees

66degrees is a leading consulting and professional services company specializing in developing Al-focused, data-led solutions leveraging the latest advancements in cloud technology. With our unmatched engineering capabilities and vast industry experience, we help the world's leading brands transform their business challenges into opportunities and shape the future of work. At 66degrees, we believe in embracing the challenge and winning together. These values not only guide us in achieving our goals as a company but also for our people. We are dedicated to creating a significant impact for our employees by fostering a culture that sparks innovation and supports professional and personal growth along the way.


Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Google Cloud and Workspace Engineer/Administrator to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for the comprehensive management and administration of all Google products, projects, sandboxes, and related infrastructure within the Google Cloud Platform (GCP), alongside the administration of Google Workspace. You will play a crucial role in ensuring the stability, security, and optimal performance of our cloud and collaboration environments.


Key Responsibilities:

Google Cloud Platform Administration:

  • Manage and administer Google Cloud projects, including creation, configuration, and resource allocation.
  • Oversee the deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of various Google Cloud services (e.g., Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, BigQuery, Kubernetes Engine).
  • Implement and enforce security best practices within GCP, including IAM, network security, and data encryption.
  • Monitor cloud resource usage, identify cost optimization opportunities, and implement efficiency improvements.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve cloud infrastructure issues in a timely manner.

Google Workspace Administration:

  • Administer and support Google Workspace services, including Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Meet, and Chat.
  • Manage user accounts, groups, organizational units, and access permissions within Google Workspace.
  • Implement and enforce security and compliance policies for Google Workspace.
  • Provide technical support and guidance to users on Google Workspace features and best practices.
  • Monitor Google Workspace usage and identify opportunities for optimization.

Cloud adoption strategy:

  • The ability to align the SLZ deployment with the larger Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and a clear business case for moving workloads to a sovereign cloud environment.
  • Manage the overall setup and configuration of SLZ

Product and Sandbox Management:

  • Administer and support various Google products and applications integrated with GCP and Google Workspace.
  • Manage and maintain sandbox environments for development, testing, and experimentation.
  • Ensure proper access control and resource allocation for sandbox users.

Automation and Scripting:

  • Develop and implement automation scripts (e.g., Python, Bash, Terraform) for routine cloud and Workspace operations and infrastructure provisioning.
  • Utilize Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles to manage and deploy cloud resources.

Monitoring and Alerting:

  • Set up and manage monitoring tools and dashboards for cloud infrastructure and applications, as well as Google Workspace.
  • Configure alerts and notifications for critical events and performance thresholds.

Network Segmentation:

  • Implement strong network segmentation using VPCs, subnets, and firewall rules to isolate different environments (e.g., production, development, staging) and workloads within the SLZ.

Identity and Access Management (IAM):

title: Senior Tekla Precast Technician
jobDescription:
Job Title - Senior Tekla Precast Technician


Ready to lead, inspire, and make your Tekla expertise count?

Step into a pivotal role where your skills don't just support projects-they drive them forward. As a Senior Tekla Technician, you'll lead a small team of talented technicians, delivering high-quality models and drawings for structural engineering projects, primarily in the Precast Concrete sector. You'll be the go-to expert, shaping designs, ensuring successful delivery, and even collaborating with our software development team to enhance Tekla-based applications.


What value does this offer you?


- Lead and grow: Take charge of a team of Tekla Technicians, honing your leadership and project management skills.

- Be the expert: Your deep knowledge of Tekla Structures-across steel and concrete-will position you as a key technical authority.

- Make an impact: See your models directly influence the success of high-profile structural projects.

- Innovate: Contribute to software development initiatives aimed at improving Tekla workflows and efficiency.


Job responsibilities


- Create detailed Tekla models and drawings aligned with project specifications.

- Collaborate with engineers and designers to develop robust structural solutions.

- Stay updated on Tekla software advancements and industry best practices.

- Support application development efforts on the Tekla platform to boost productivity and precision.

- Prepare detailed 3D models of reinforced concrete and precast structures including rebar modeling using Tekla software in a timely manner and within a given budget.

- Generate and edit detailed drawings of reinforced concrete and precast structures using Tekla software in a timely manner and within a given budget.

- Prepare structural drawings like plans, elevations, sections and details including reinforcement detailing and preparation of bar bending schedules.

- Prepare precast erection drawings, production drawings, hardware drawings and material lists.

- Review and analyze the project documents identifying drawing and specification conflicts, insufficient information, and missing dimensions.

- Coordinate and communicate with team members.

- Working as part of a project team to provide deliverables and meet deadlines while providing quality control/ quality assurance to ensure these deliverables are on-time and of a high quality.

- Planning and organize work priorities to ensure drawings meet the project deadlines.

- Reviews and check precast shop drawings, piece tickets, and fabrication materials for compliance to production and drawing standards.

- Review and check precast erection plans and elevation drawings, checking all dimensions against contract documents and standards.

- Ensure adequate information is correctly interpreted and included on drawings

- Conformance of shop drawings with contract documents and quantity takeoff.

- Consistency of drawing presentation with production methods and standards.


Job specification


- Bachelors degree in Civil or Structural Engineering with a minimum of 5 to 7 years of experience

- Proven experience with Tekla Structures-precast concrete expertise preferred.

- Prior experience managing or mentoring a team of technicians.

- Strong grasp of structural engineering principles and construction methodologies.

- Extensive knowledge and working experience with Tekla Structures software.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

- Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines confidently.

- Ability to satisfactorily read, understands, and interpret architectural and structural drawings.

- Strong attention to detail with proficient level of accuracy.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify and resolve issues in a timely manner.

- Flexible attitude, in an environment with frequently changing deadlines can be relied on to meet deadlines.


Salary : INR 6,50,000 - 8,50,000/ annum

title: Regional Sales Manager
jobDescription:
Role Summary

The Regional Sales Manager (RSM) will be responsible for developing and executing the sales strategy for their assigned region, managing a sales team, building key client relationships, and ensuring ENH iSecure meets or exceeds its revenue goals. This role demands a seasoned sales leader with deep expertise in technology sales, a strong understanding of IAM, and a proven track record of exceeding sales targets in a competitive market.

The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker with excellent communication skills, a data-driven approach to decision-making, and the ability to inspire and lead a team.

Key Responsibilities

1. Sales Strategy Development and Execution
• Develop and implement a regional sales strategy aligned with ENH iSecures national goals, focusing on key industries such as finance, healthcare, technology, and government.
• Identify new business opportunities, key target accounts, and strategic prospects within the region.
• Set clear revenue and performance targets for the region and take proactive steps to achieve or exceed those goals.
2. Key Account Management
• Personally manage relationships with high-value clients, serving as the primary point of contact and building strong, trust-based partnerships.
• Conduct in-depth account planning to understand client needs, pain points, and potential for upsell/cross-sell opportunities.
• Act as a liaison between the client and ENH iSecure’s technical, support, and service teams to ensure client satisfaction and prompt issue resolution.
3. Pipeline and Forecast Management
• Oversee the regional sales pipeline, ensuring that it is strong and balanced to achieve revenue targets.
• Monitor and analyze pipeline health, conversion rates, and deal progression; provide accurate sales forecasts and performance reports to the National Sales Director.
• Implement tools and best practices for pipeline management, ensuring sales reps effectively qualify and prioritize opportunities.
4. Collaboration with Cross-Functional Teams
• Work closely with marketing to develop region-specific campaigns, content, and events that support lead generation and brand awareness.
• Partner with the product and technical teams to ensure that sales pitches are accurate, relevant, and aligned with ENH iSecure’s capabilities.
• Provide feedback to the leadership team on product trends, client demands, and market dynamics that may impact sales strategies.
5. Market Research and Competitive Analysis
• Conduct regular research on IAM industry trends, competitor activities, and regulatory changes within the region to stay ahead of market shifts.
• Identify gaps in ENH iSecure’s offerings and areas for growth; develop strategies to position ENH iSecure as a preferred provider in the IAM market.
6. Revenue and Growth Management
• Meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales targets, both for product sales and professional services.
• Drive revenue growth by identifying and capturing upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts.
• Develop a structured approach for managing and growing recurring revenue and customer retention rates.
7. Sales Process Optimization
• Implement and optimize sales processes within the region to improve efficiency, consistency, and effectiveness.
• Utilize CRM and other sales tools to streamline workflow, track customer interactions, and measure performance.
• Ensure adherence to sales protocols, from lead qualification through contract negotiation and closing.
8. Event Participation and Networking
• Represent ENH iSecure at industry events, conferences, and webinars, enhancing the company’s visibility and building professional networks.
• Plan and host regional client roundtables, seminars, or webinars to drive brand awareness and engage prospective clients.
9. Reporting and Performance Analysis
• Track and analyze key performance metrics (KPIs) related to revenue, pipeline, win rates, and productivity.
• Generate detailed reports for senior management, highlighting key insights, growth areas, and recommended actions.
• Adjust sales strategy based on performance data and feedback from team members and clients.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Experience:
    • 8+ years of B2B sales experience, with a minimum of 4 years in a regional or senior sales role within technology or cybersecurity sectors.
    • Proven success in selling IAM solutions or related cybersecurity technologies (SailPoint, Okta, CyberArk, etc.) is highly preferred.
    • Knowledge:
    • Strong understanding of IAM and cybersecurity concepts, challenges, and regulatory compliance needs, especially within India.
    • Knowledge of sales processes, pipeline management, and strategic account planning, with experience using CRM tools like Salesforce or HubSpot.
    • Skills:
    • Exceptional leadership skills, able to inspire, coach, and drive a high-performing sales team.
    • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to C-level and technical audiences alike.
    • Analytical and data-driven mindset, skilled in identifying trends, analyzing performance metrics, and adjusting strategy accordingly.
    • Attributes:
    • Results-oriented, with a strong drive to achieve and exceed sales targets.
    • Self-motivated, with a proactive approach to identifying and capitalizing on new business opportunities.
    • Collaborative and adaptable, with the ability to work effectively across departments and with various stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or related field (MBA preferred).
    • Experience managing complex sales cycles within enterprise and large accounts.
    • Certifications in sales, cybersecurity, or IAM

What ENH iSecure Offers

  • Career Advancement: A growth-oriented role with opportunities for career development and industry certifications.
    • Compensation: Competitive salary package, including base pay and performance-based incentives.
    • Culture: An innovative, team-focused environment where you can impact the cybersecurity landscape.
    • Benefits: Health benefits, paid time off, and flexible work options.

In this role, you will:

  • Create clear and effective data models, solutions and architectures, ensuring alignment with the overall data architecture and project goals.

  • Develop and implement best practices for data modelling, including naming conventions, documentation, and version control.

  • Demonstrable experience in solution architecture, data modelling and data architecture.

  • Familiarity with ETL processes and data integration tools.
  • Experience with cloud-based (GCP, AWS, Azure), on-prem and hybrid data architectures and solutions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and documentation abilities.

In addition to the above, the following background experience would be highly beneficial:

  • Consultancy / customer facing experience within a software vendor or enterprise scale services environment.
  • Financial Services domain knowledge with practical experience of mobilizing technology to meet the market dynamics effecting the financial services domain (Risk / Cost / Customer).
  • A track record of successful refactoring / tech-debt remediation projects.
  • Exposure or experience of big data and big data technologies.

  • Experience in digital and broader architectural transformation, applying solutions from experience, decomposing monolithic solutions and applying methods to manage technical debt.
  • Experience working with enterprise architectures, translating those into solution and data architectures.
  • Adherence to architecture governance practices and procedures.

title: Data Engineer
jobDescription:
Senior DE:

Same as above but need to have experience managing data engineers, have experience working with stakeholders, actively engaging for key technical discussion and have a very good technical knowledge. Should have at least 7 years experience working in data engineering.

Job responsibilities

  • Software design, Scala and Python - Spark development experience, automated testing of new and existing components in an Agile, DevOps and dynamic environment.
  • Minimum 1 year experience in Scala
  • Promoting development standards, code reviews, mentoring, knowledge sharing
  • Production support & troubleshooting.
  • Implement the tools and processes, handling performance, scale, availability, accuracy and monitoring
  • Liaison with BAs to ensure that requirements are correctly interpreted and implemented.
  • Participation in regular planning and status meetings. Input to the development process – through the involvement in Sprint reviews and retrospectives. Input into system architecture and design.

To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements: (Must have Requirements)

  • Scala and Python development and understanding requirements and come up solutions.
  • Experience using scheduling tools such as Airflow.
  • Experience with most of the following technologies (Apache Hadoop, Pyspark, Apache Spark, YARN, Hive, Python, ETL frameworks, Map Reduce, SQL, RESTful services).
  • Sound knowledge of working in Unix/Linux Platform
  • Hands-on experience building data pipelines using Hadoop components - Hive, Spark, Spark SQL.
  • Experience with industry standard version control tools (Git, GitHub), automated deployment tools (Ansible & Jenkins) and requirement management in JIRA.
  • Understanding of big data modelling techniques using relational and non-relational techniques
  • Experience on debugging code issues and then publishing the highlighted differences to the development team.
  • Flexible to adapt to new tooling.

The successful candidate will also meet the following requirements: (Good to have Requirements)

  • Experience with Elastic search.
  • Experience developing in Java APIs.
  • Experience doing ingestions.
  • Understanding or experience of Cloud design pattern
  • GCP Development experience
  • Exposure to DevOps & Agile Project methodology such as Scrum and Kanban.

This role offers the opportunity to be part of an innovative team, delivering impactful solutions while developing your technical expertise.

title: Golang Developer - B2C SaaS
jobDescription:
We need a Golang expert who lives and breathes microservices architecture. You'll join a team of 6 exceptional Go engineers building video processing pipelines, real-time analytics, and social media API integrations that serve 100,000+ creators. This is 80% hands-on coding writing efficient, concurrent Go code that scales.


We're a profitable, AI-first SaaS startup building social media automation tools. Our platform processes millions of videos, analyzes performance in real-time, and orchestrates publishing across multiple platforms. The technical challenge? Building efficient abstractions across our service architecture without sacrificing performance.


About Us

We're not your typical startup. We're profitable, product-led, and we've spent the last 6 months building an AI-first development culture that makes our engineers ship faster and better. No VC drama, no runway anxiety just pure execution on a product that creators actually pay for.

Our engineering team uses AI as a core development partner Claude Code, custom RAG systems, and context engineering methods that help us achieve great results the first time. We're looking for a Golang engineer who sees this as the future of development, not a threat to job security.


The Role

You'll be one of 6 senior Go engineers in a flat, collaborative team where everyone is exceptionally skilled. No hierarchy, no politics just talented engineers solving complex problems together. You'll report to our Head of Engineering who has deep Go expertise and knows when to guide versus when to get out of the way.

This is primarily a coding role (80% of your time). You'll write Go services using Gin framework, orchestrate async workflows with AWS SQS, and build data layers on PostgreSQL. The remaining 20% is collaborating on architecture decisions designing service boundaries, API contracts, and finding the right abstractions that make our system both powerful and maintainable.


What You'll Actually Do

  • Build microservices using Gin framework that handle video processing, analytics, and social media integrations
  • Design and implement gRPC services for efficient inter-service communication
  • Write concurrent Go code that processes millions of social media posts using goroutines and channels
  • Architect async workflows with AWS SQS for reliable, scalable job processing
  • Optimize PostgreSQL queries and data models for services handling real-time analytics
  • Find the right abstractions that simplify our architecture without creating performance bottlenecks
  • Collaborate with 5-6 peer engineers on service design and API contracts
  • Ship production code daily — no lengthy design phases or committee approvals
  • Profile and optimize critical paths when performance matters

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of professional Golang experience building software products — not DevOps tools, not data pipelines, but actual Go-based products that users interact with
  • Deep expertise with microservices architecture and service decomposition
  • Production experience with our exact stack: Gin framework, AWS SQS, PostgreSQL
  • gRPC expertise for building high-performance service communication
  • Mastery of Go's concurrency model — you know when to use channels vs mutexes vs atomic operations
  • Experience building efficient abstractions that balance flexibility with performance
  • Product company background — you've built backend systems for user-facing products, not internal tools
  • Strong PostgreSQL skills including query optimization and proper indexing strategies
  • Infrastructure-as-Code experience with AWS CDK or Terraform
  • Currently based in Bangalore with ability to work from our Koramangala office — we need someone who can start within 30 days, not interstate transfers

You're The Right Person If

  • You've spent years building Go-based products where Go was the primary language, not a supporting player
  • You can design service boundaries that make sense and don't create distributed monoliths
  • You write Go code that's idiomatic, not just functional
  • You understand that efficient abstraction is about finding the sweet spot between DRY and performance
  • You enjoy working with peer engineers who are as good as (or better than) you
  • You can explain why your microservice needs its own database (or why it doesn't)
  • You optimise for the team's velocity, not just your own

What We Offer

  • Join a team of 6 exceptional Go engineers — everyone here can code, review, and architect
  • Work on real technical challenges: video processing at scale, real-time analytics, multi-platform orchestration
  • Modern tech stack with zero legacy: Gin, gRPC, AWS SQS, PostgreSQL
  • AI-first culture where you'll use cutting-edge development tools daily
  • Flat team structure — collaborate with peers, not navigate hierarchy
  • Competitive compensation with meaningful equity in a profitable company
  • Daily catered lunches via Zomato Enterprise
  • Comprehensive health insurance for you and dependents
  • Learning budget for courses, conferences, and certifications
  • Direct impact — your code ships to production, not into committees

In Summary

This role is for someone who has built their career on Go — not dabbled in it, not used it for scripts, but architected and delivered software services where Go was the backbone. You'll write efficient microservices, design clean service boundaries, and optimise performance where it matters.


You'll work with engineers who are all senior, all exceptional, and all focused on shipping great code. If you've spent 5+ years building Go-based products and want to solve real scaling challenges with a team that matches your expertise — let's talk.
